description: Sensores Conteo Bicicleta Bogotá D C is a dataset listed in City of Bogotá open data portal (Datos Abiertos Bogotá), an open data portal, published or maintained by Secretaría Distrital de Movilidad - SDM. Sensores para el aforo de bicicletas que pasan por un tramo de ciclorutas por minuto. Coverage: Bogotá. The portal files it under the publisher Secretaría Distrital de Movilidad - SDM. Its tags are Sensor, aforo, bicicletas, ciclousuario, conteo. It offers 6 resource(s) in CSV, ESRI REST, GEOJSON, HTML, KML. The portal shows 2020-02-17 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bogota-portal.
